modalities.label: Co-investment (early stage)
modalities.summary: The government invests alongside an independent, qualified third-party investor, on the published ratios.

modalities.label: Direct investment (growth stage)
modalities.summary: SG Growth Capital can lead or co-lead, in a round with at least one other institutional investor. No ratio is published.

modalities.label: Fund-of-funds
modalities.summary: Investment in venture capital funds (minimum fund size S$30 million). Not used by this app.

general_tech.label: General tech
general_tech.conflict: Two official pages differ. The SEEDS Capital page (updated 2 July 2026) still lists a general tech row. The Startup SG eligibility page (updated 05 Oct 2026, parameters as of 27 Feb 2026) describes the scheme for deep tech start-ups only. The app shows this row for reference and never recommends capital on it. Confirm with the team.

focus_domains: Smart Nation and Digital Economy deep tech (quantum, cybersecurity, generative AI)

gates.label: Incorporated 10 years or less
gates.note: The FAQ says the 10-year limit does not extend to growth-stage start-ups.

gates.label: Develops or possesses its innovations in Singapore
Deep tech: owns research-based IP that is differentiated or proprietary
Primary focus in one of the six listed domain areas
Independent third-party co-investor with a matching commitment
Not an excluded activity (real estate development, consultancy, gambling, HR recruitment, tobacco, loan and lease finance)

criteria.label: Innovation and IP
criteria.basis: SEEDS Capital attribute 1: substantial innovative or intellectual property content developed or owned in-house.
anchors: 1: no IP of its own
2: IP is claimed but nothing is filed or shown
3: patent applications filed or proprietary know-how, not yet tested outside the lab
4: patents filed or granted, plus pilot or validation data showing the technology works
5: granted patents in key markets and performance confirmed by an independent party

criteria.label: Commercial viability and traction
criteria.basis: SEEDS Capital attribute 2: a commercially viable business model, including some pilot or paying customers.
anchors: 1: no customers and no clear model
2: pre-revenue, with pilots or studies agreed but not started
3: pilots running or first revenue
4: paying customers, with renewals or growing revenue
5: strong recurring revenue and sound unit economics

criteria.label: Value proposition and scalability
criteria.basis: SEEDS Capital attribute 3: a clear value proposition that can scale in its customer segment and across international markets.
anchors: 1: unclear who buys it or why
2: clear in one niche; the path to scale is not addressed
3: clear value proposition and a credible plan to scale
4: value shown in customer results or data, with a funded plan to scale beyond Singapore
5: already selling across several markets

criteria.label: Management team
criteria.basis: SEEDS Capital attribute 4: a committed and capable management team with relevant experience, receptive to guidance from co-investors.
anchors: 1: the evidence shows key roles unfilled and no relevant experience
2: gaps in key roles
3: relevant experience in the core roles
4: experienced team covering technology, operations and commercial, with industry track records
5: repeat founders with exits, or senior industry leaders

criteria.label: Market potential
criteria.basis: Size and growth of the market the product sells into, from independent sources where they exist.
anchors: 1: a small market on the evidence
2: a niche under US$1 billion
3: US$1 billion to US$10 billion, growing
4: over US$10 billion, or growing over 20% a year, on an independent source
5: very large and fast-growing, on several independent sources that agree

criteria.label: Competitive position
criteria.basis: Who else sells this, how the start-up differs, and how much of a customer's spend it already wins (share of wallet).
anchors: 1: stronger rivals and no difference shown
2: a difference is claimed only
3: a clear technical difference; rivals are better funded
4: differentiated, with customer wins or a meaningful share of a customer's spend
5: the clear leader in its segment

criteria.label: Relevance to Singapore
criteria.basis: Strategic and economic relevance: innovation, jobs and operations anchored in Singapore, in a listed focus area.
anchors: 1: no Singapore presence
2: registered in Singapore only
3: team and R&D in Singapore
4: R&D, IP and most jobs in Singapore, in a listed focus area
5: as 4, plus manufacturing or regional operations anchored in Singapore

assumptions: Tier limits are read as the government's own cumulative investment in the start-up (the SEEDS Capital page words them as 'from SEEDS').
The 2:1 first tier applies only to a first institutional round; when the documents do not say, the app uses 1:1, the lower figure.
Earlier government equity in the start-up counts toward the S$12 million cap; when the documents do not mention any, the app assumes none and says so.

Pre-seed to Series B is treated as early stage (co-investment) and Series C onward as growth stage (direct). The EDB release of 28 Oct 2024 describes early to early-growth as roughly Seed to Series B/C; the split is this app's assumption.
The matched amount is a ceiling under the published schedule. It is not a valuation and not a decision; the team decides.
Amounts are in Singapore dollars. A round quoted in another currency is not converted; the calculator is left for the reviewer.

When under half of what the desk looks for was found, or under 60% of the score's weight could be rated, the app makes no first-meeting call and suggests getting the company's documents: little public evidence is not the same as a weak company.
workstreams_basis: What a portfolio growth team works across, in the words of SG Growth Capital's own job posting for that team: Singapore landing plans, go-to-market access, R&D and centre-of-excellence development, and talent support; investor engagement is from the same posting's list of programmes.

workstreams.label: Go-to-market access
workstreams.covers: customers, pilots, partners, suppliers, channels and introductions

workstreams.label: Singapore landing plan
workstreams.covers: setting up or expanding operations, sites and regulatory steps in Singapore

workstreams.label: R&D and centre of excellence
workstreams.covers: research partners, laboratories, pilot lines, validation studies and scale-up

workstreams.label: Talent
workstreams.covers: key roles that are missing, and hiring as the team grows

workstreams.label: Investor engagement
workstreams.covers: lead investors and co-investors for the round
